name: manual_2488f7
claim: Receiver acceptance is not content-identity proof: ok, received_at and a matching byte count establish that a receiver accepted a transfer, not that the receiver holds the intended bytes. Treat delivery as content-verified only when the receiver reports or independently verifies a matching cryptographic digest. For reciprocal delivery claims require a verified peer CA on the connection and a receipt hash that the receiver recomputes from its stored bytes. State which digest form the hash uses, raw bytes or LF-normalized. Report a raw-byte match as byte identity. Report an LF-normalized match only as normalized equivalence, not byte identity. Otherwise report accepted delivery with the content-identity limitation.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit PT#495 thread 4557491096: LF-normalized receipt match is normalized equivalence, not byte identity; state digest form.
